title.narrative: Institutional development to modernise waste management in Kosovo

description.narrative: To enhance the capacities of the relevant institutions to modernize SWM in Kosovo through technical assistance measures. Main outputs are: A) The institutional and legislative frame-work for the waste management sector have been improved, B) The economic potential of circular economy is developed and C) Waste sector specific expertise of national and local governmental and non-governmental actors has improved.
